dedupe_keys.name: insee population census 2023 complete dossier for french guiana with the overseas housing comfort table electricity hot water indoor bath and wc sewer connection for the department and each commune plus the national dossier database in parquet

description: INSEE's complete dossier for the department of French Guiana presents results of the rolling population census for 2012, 2017 and 2023, and it includes a housing comfort table used only for the overseas departments. That table counts main residences with electricity in the dwelling, hot water, a bath or shower and WC inside, and a connection to the public sewer. In 2023, 80,548 of 88,425 main residences (91.1 percent) had electricity and 49.6 percent were connected to the sewer. Other tables give dwelling counts since 1968, houses and flats, tenure and cars. Coverage is the department and, through the same page with a commune code, each commune; the whole set of indicators for all communes is published as a 307 MB Parquet file and as CSV. Format and access: free HTML tables and bulk downloads, no registration. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): etalab-2.0 (INSEE: data on the site under Licence Ouverte 2.0). Caveats: some cells are suppressed for statistical confidentiality; for Saint-Barthélemy, Saint-Martin and Saint-Pierre the dossier had no housing tables. Simulation uses: gaps in electricity and sewer connection by commune for network planning in a territory with many unconnected settlements. Related records: the INSEE infra-municipal housing base by IRIS.
